definitions: To delay action or a decision on something.
To keep a secret or information hidden.
To be a member of a committee, jury, or board.
To suppress or try to prevent the publication or release of something.
To be located directly above and supported by something.
examples: The committee decided to sit on the proposal for another month.
She's been sitting on some important news.
He was asked to sit on the new advisory board.
The government tried to sit on the report.
The house sits on a hill overlooking the ocean.
